objective: Test whether the frozen defined-risk short-put-spread structure, entered under the same global calm/no-eruption/magnitude regime the live P5 lane requires, clears the canonical overfit gate when replayed across the frozen liquid-ETF universe over the available local price history.
motivation: options_gate_v1 produced only 16-24 non-overlapping SPY observations per strategy, so canonical PBO (>=40 trades) was unavailable and no verdict was possible. Replaying the same rule across nine ETFs raises the observation count enough for the gate to render an honest verdict.

scope.mode: offline research; SHADOW advisory only; no broker integration
scope.price_source: local qlib_lab/csv/<asset>.csv, Yahoo back-adjustment undone via the factor column

global_veto.note: identical fields to the live lane; replayed point-in-time from the macro_gpu_lab shift detector

contracts.expiry_rule: monthly third-Friday nearest 45 DTE inside the window
contracts.long_put: same expiry, exactly spread_width below the short strike (frozen per symbol)
contracts.entry_price: Black-Scholes model credit at entry IV; the live lane uses a strictly worse natural bid/ask credit

entry_policy.costs: BACKTEST_COST_PER_LEG_RT applied per leg, round trip
entry_policy.settlement: hold to expiration, intrinsic value at the last available close on or before expiry (canonical; no take-profit, stop-loss, or DTE exit)
entry_policy.non_overlap: one open position per (symbol, strategy); a new entry is refused until the prior expiry has passed

declared_deviations_from_the_live_lane.deviation: no Qlib per-asset bullish discovery filter
declared_deviations_from_the_live_lane.reason: Qlib lean/conviction is a live flag with no per-asset point-in-time replay available offline; re-running Qlib walk-forward per asset is out of scope.
declared_deviations_from_the_live_lane.consequence: The backtest population is a SUPERSET of live-lane entries. Results describe the structure plus global regime, not the exact live rule. A pass here does NOT by itself promote the live lane.

declared_deviations_from_the_live_lane.deviation: implied volatility is proxied, not observed
declared_deviations_from_the_live_lane.reason: Only SPY has a listed IV history (VIX) in the local store.
declared_deviations_from_the_live_lane.method: entry IV for every symbol = RV20(symbol) * premium_factor, where premium_factor = (VIX/100) / RV20(SPY) on that date.
declared_deviations_from_the_live_lane.consequence: Because premium_factor is a single market-wide scalar, the live lane's per-asset IV/RV ratio test DEGENERATES to a market-wide condition and cannot discriminate between assets. This backtest therefore cannot validate the per-asset IV/RV filter; it validates structure plus global regime only. Never present proxied IV as observed IV.

declared_deviations_from_the_live_lane.deviation: model credit instead of natural bid/ask credit
declared_deviations_from_the_live_lane.reason: no historical option bid/ask data on this box
declared_deviations_from_the_live_lane.consequence: entry pricing is optimistic relative to live execution; treat measured edge as an upper bound

independence_and_inference.problem: SPY, QQQ, DIA and IWM are highly correlated; pooling their same-date entries would fake independent observations and inflate both n and any PBO/DSR verdict.
independence_and_inference.required_handling: cluster same-date entries: all positions opened on one entry date collapse to a single clustered observation equal to the mean PnL of that date's entries.
reported_views: pooled — every (symbol, entry) observation, naive and known to overstate independence
cluster_adjusted — one observation per entry date (HEADLINE; the only view a promotion decision may use)

trial_accounting.reason: one frozen strategy hypothesis per each of the nine universe symbols; every future structure or parameter variant must increase this count
trial_accounting.no_threshold_softening: Canonical thresholds are fixed: PBO < 0.5 AND Deflated Sharpe > 0. A high raw profit factor never overrides a failed DSR or an unavailable PBO.

promotion: No promotion. A pass changes only a display badge. Live promotion additionally requires the Qlib filter to be validated, natural-pricing confirmation, >=40 settled cluster-adjusted observations, and human review.
